Description: Manufacturers' new orders: nondefense capital goods excluding aircraft (core capital goods orders)
Source: FRED / ALFRED (pinned vintages; U.S. Census Bureau, advance durable goods / M3)
Direction Convention: Higher growth = stronger business equipment demand
Known Quirks: Trending nominal level, so the signals are growth rates; first printed in the advance durable-goods report about 26 days after month-end and revised in the full M3 report; extreme 2020-21 swings
Display Note: Nominal, not inflation-adjusted. Core capital goods only, not total manufacturing new orders.
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
